metric_compatibility_strengthening.name: QZL — Q-Zero Law
metric_compatibility_strengthening.meaning: SMRRL alone gives a regular metric-affine limit, not Levi-Civita compatibility. QZL is the separate asymptotic condition selecting the metric-compatible sector.

section_independence.candidate: SMAVT — Score-Metric Asymptotic Vertical Triviality: lawful refinement sections must have transported Q_h differences ->0
section_independence.meaning: SMRRL ensures existence along one selected tower; it does not ensure all lawful score/refinement towers have the same nonmetricity limit.

minimal_dependency_map.emergent_metric_compatible_limit: SMRRL + SMAVT + QZL (or one stronger law implying all three)
